Class ProfileGoalMapper

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.service.ProfileGoalMapper
public final class ProfileGoalMapper extends Object
Translates between FitnessGoal and the flat fields on LocalProfileStore.

The store is the shared state the whole app and its ProfileDAO already read and write, and it is not this feature's to redesign. This adapter lets the goals screen work with a real domain object while the persistence layer keeps seeing the fields it expects, so neither side has to change for the other.

The two enums are matched by name(), which holds because GoalType and LocalProfileStore.PrimaryGoal declare the same constants — and toGoal(LocalProfileStore) returns empty rather than throwing if that ever stops being true.
